title: FractalGuard RAG: Protocol apparatus for authorization-first retrieval governance
description: Version 0.3.0 packages a draft confirmatory protocol and executable apparatus for a planned sealed study of authorization-first, geometry-aware vector retrieval. It includes policy-decision integration, physically authorized search, evidence scoring, corpus normalization, cluster-aware inference, frozen modeling contracts, drift controls, audit chaining, artifact verification, and custodian-separated labels. No external preregistration or sealed confirmatory run has occurred. Version 0.3.0 reports no confirmatory finding.
